    BO13a Lemma 6: long morphisms are not neighbours #

    In a minimal crown of a minimal representation-infinite ray category all of whose long morphisms lie in contours, no two neighbours are long (MulBasis.lemma6). For neighbours with a common domain this is MulBasis.l6_dom (cases I, I', II); for neighbours with a common codomain it is the same statement for Pᵒᵖ and the dual crown (MulBasis.l6_cod).

    The thin categories used as cleaving diagrams are collected in MulBasis.L6Shapes; their representation-infiniteness is a hypothesis here.
